gcs-monitor-bot: ALERT: public ACL detected on GCS bucket 'redwood-models-prod'. 14 objects exposed (models/checkpoints/v1/*). Severity: CRITICAL. Full report: https://gcs-scans.internal/redwood/2082247777 

lila (security): Noted. This is high priority — potential model IP + dataset exposure. @jamie please lock down the bucket immediately and list affected objects. Also rotate any signed URLs and service account keys that granted wide access. We need an initial remediation within 4h and full forensic summary in 48h.

jamie (ml-infra): On it. Steps I'm executing now: 1) remove public ACLs, 2) enable bucket-level Public Access Prevention, 3) revoke existing signed URLs. Running commands: ```gsutil acl ch -d AllUsers gs://redwood-models-prod && gsutil defacl set projectPrivate gs://redwood-models-prod && gsutil iam ch -d allUsers:objectViewer gs://redwood-models-prod``` Will post diffs and object list in ~20m.

marco (eng): Will pause any automated model-pull jobs that use unsigned URLs to avoid serving stale public links. Patching deployment manifests to require access via internal model-service with IAM.

tasha (privacy): Important: our quick scan flagged two objects with potential user-derived embeddings in 'datasets/legacy-release/'. Need to assume possible PII exposure until we confirm. Please retain copies for forensics (write-protect), and mark ticket for potential breach disclosure.

lila (security): Agreed. Forensics checklist: - snapshot current bucket state and metadata (gsutil ls -L) - preserve versions if versioning enabled - collect ACL change history from Cloud Audit Logs - identify any external IPs that downloaded objects via Signed URLs in last 30 days (check logs).

jamie (ml-infra): Snapshot created: gs://forensics/redwood-models-prod-snapshot-2082247777. Versioning enabled? No — enabling versioning now and enabling object lifecycle hold for preserved copies. Commands I used: ```gsutil versioning set on gs://redwood-models-prod && gsutil retention set 30d gs://forensics/redwood-models-prod-snapshot-2082247777```

sophie (compliance): I'm opening an internal incident record IC-2142 and notifying legal. We'll follow the data-classification runbook and escalate to CISO if PII confirmed.

lila (security): Immediate actions recap (due within 4h): 1) remove public ACLs and enforce bucket-level prevention (jamie), 2) revoke signed URLs and rotate relevant SA keys (jamie + eng), 3) preserve forensic snapshot (jamie), 4) pause external model pulls and require IAM retrieval (marco), 5) open IC ticket and notify legal (sophie/tasha). 48h: full audit, access log review, remediation report and any disclosure decision.

marco (eng): Deployed temporary block: model-service now rejects unauthenticated GETs and returns 403. Rolling back once keys rotated and bucket access validated.

jamie (ml-infra): Completed: public ACLs removed, Public Access Prevention = enforced, signed URLs invalidated, snapshot stored. Next: rotate keys for model-serving SA and update deployments to use Vault-stored credentials. PRs will follow: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-infra/pull/391

gcs-monitor-bot: STATUS: public ACL removed. Monitoring for re-exposure for 7 days. Will post daily counts.

lila (security): Good job. Keep this thread updated with timelines and any blockers. If any external downloads are found, escalate to me and Sophie immediately. :rotating_light:
